topic: Foreign Accent Syndrome: A brain anomaly causing a sudden, unlearned foreign accent.
title: His Brain Invented a NEW Accent Overnight 🤯
script: (Fast cuts, unsettling yet intriguing music) He went to bed an ordinary man... woke up the next morning... with a foreign accent! No travel, no exposure, just a sudden shift in his brain's wiring after a minor trauma. Scientists call it Foreign Accent Syndrome. His mind literally started speaking a dialect it had never heard. Did his brain unlock a hidden linguistic blueprint? Or is this proof of just how bizarrely adaptable our minds truly are? Mind. Blown.
